title: Clean managed-app build and live SharePoint comparison
design: Five model/effort configurations, each repeated twice in reverse-order blocks; ten fresh tasks and apps; controller-only review.

controls.scope: Dashboard, Catalogue, New request, My requests. Approval/rejection, approver roles, inventory editing and app reset are excluded.
controls.fixtureRule: Only the external controller restores the registered synthetic fixture with exact ETags and independently verifies it. Preserve state before cleanup; reject foreign rows. Do not attribute any unmeasured runtime charges.
controls.approvalRule: Only registered lists and the existing working demo-account connection. No admin center, policy changes, publication, sharing, unrelated resources or connection deletion.
controls.reviewRule: Controller browser/backend testing and scoring only. Cowork receives the frozen build prompt and narrowly evidenced repair requests, never a generic review, audit or acceptance-testing prompt.
controls.costRule: Observe actual cumulative task credits after first delivery, after each repair and at session end. Retain exact cards. No native review prompts. Do not deduct estimated review costs or pool superseded results.
controls.stopRule: Per run: acceptance, two corrections or thirty observed active-generation minutes. Pause for unresolved common platform blockers. Preserve failures and never silently replace them.
controls.timingRule: Submission-to-first completed output and submission-to-final externally reviewed result are separate. Include and disclose instrumentation/interruption time. Acceptance time exists only when accepted.
controls.comparisonRule: Only this fresh cohort enters the current comparison. Selected Cowork settings are observed, internal builder routing is unknown unless exposed. Prior scopes and paid-review methods remain excluded audit history.

buildBudget.rule: Conservatively count both earlier demo app builds toward the twenty-build ceiling. This protocol authorizes only the ten enumerated fresh runs; no hidden replacements or automatic extension.
